message: I remember a time when my phone ran out of battery just when I needed it most—right before a thunderstorm rolled in. It made me realize how important it is to have a plan, especially for the little ones. The resource I found is a wonderful guide for teaching kids about being prepared in various situations, even if technology decides to take a break. It's all about giving them the tools to feel safe and confident, no matter what. Have you thought about how to involve your kids in your family's preparedness plans?
